F. No. AS&EC/ANRF-ECRG /2025/JRF Advt. Date: 10-10-2026
Walk in Interview (Online/Offline)
Applications are hereby invited from eligible candidates through online/offline mode for hiring of technical manpower
[Junior Research Fellow: 01] on purely contract basis for engagement in research with the project entitled “Development
of Device for nondestructive estimation of tender coconut water volume” under “ANRF-Early Career Research
Grant” funded by Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). The appointment will be purely temporary under
contractual and co-terminus basis, following the prescribed procedure for six months or till the completion date of the
project and may be extended based on work proficiency of the recruited project staff. The appointments may be
terminated at any time without notice or assigning any reason thereof. The candidates possessing required qualifications
given below may appear before selection committee in the Seminar Room, AS&EC Division, ICAR-Central Institute of
Post-Harvest Engineering and Technology (CIPHET), PO: PAU, Ludhiana-141004 (Punjab) or via Zoom Link (shared via
email to the screened candidates before date of interview).

Nature of Work:
Primary place of work will be at ICAR-CIPHET, Ludhiana. However, the candidate may be asked to travel (if
needed) for the research activity. Research works involve device development, its performance evaluation,
record keeping and assistance to PI in project management, etc.
Duration of engagement of the Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
Initial engagement of JRF will be for one year, which may be extended subject to performance and requirement
of the services of the JRF in the project/Institute.
Tax deduction at source
The income tax or any other tax is to be deducted as per the rule.
Attendance and working hours/days: As per the ICAR rules.
Application Process:
Eligible candidates must bring the duly filled application in the enclosed proforma (Annexure I& II) along with
self-attested photocopies of the documents and original documents at the time of the Interview or the duly
documents forms can be mailed on abhinaviari001@gmail.com before 13.11. 2026.
Other terms and conditions
i.) The engagement will not constitute a regular job or appointment in the ICAR.
ii.) During the term of engagement, the JRF shall comply with the Standards of Conduct. Failure to comply
with the same will become grounds for termination of the JRF without notice.
Terms & Conditions
➢ The above position is purely temporary and will be filled on a contractual basis. The post is coterminous
with the project and will be offered initially for one year or till termination of the project, whichever is
earlier.
➢ Candidates will be selected through Interview based on their academic qualification, experience,
publication, achievements/awards, etc. which are submitted by the candidates in his/her application form
(Annexure I).
Place of Walk – in - interview: AS & EC Division, ICAR-CIPHET, Behind Radhaswamy Satsang Ghar,
Hambran Road, Ludhiana 141004
Date of Interview: 13.11.2026 Interview Reporting Time: 11:00 AM
o The selected candidate will not be entitled to claim regular appointments/ absorption in this institute/
ICAR/ANRF. Non-maintenance of the discipline and failure to perform the assigned duties will make
the JRF liable for termination during the appointment period as per ICAR rules.
o The selected candidate will be required to produce all the original documents and medical fitness
certificates at the time of joining.
o Candidates should bring their complete biodata, duly self-attested certificates, and mark sheets (from
Class 10th onwards), thesis/publications, training/experience certificates, and no objection certificate
from their current employer during the interview. Only the candidates having essential qualifications
would be allowed to attend the Interview.
o No TA/DA/remuneration will be paid for attending the Interview or joining if selected.
o Candidates, whose near / distant relative is an employee of the ICAR/ICAR-CIPHET, Ludhiana must
furnish a declaration (Annexure II). Candidates having no near/ distant relative(s) working at ICAR/
ICAR-CIPHET, Ludhiana will also furnish a declaration (Annexure II) on the date of interview.
o Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature. Concealing facts or canvassing in any form shall
lead to disqualification or termination.
o All the terms & conditions will be followed as per the revised guidelines of ANRF/ICAR from time to
time.
o The Director or the PI of the project, ICAR-CIPHET, Ludhiana, reserves the right to cancel / withdraw
the above position and retains the right to not select any candidate/scrap any of the positions even after
the Interview. The decision of the Director or the PI of the project, ICAR-CIPHET, Ludhiana shall be
final and binding on all aspects.
